propositions: Impact-present ticket closes perform a full tracker-directory walk per unique historical reference candidate (short-id or prefix forms), scaling O(unique_candidates × tracker_size) in commit_impact.referencing_commits.
resolve_ticket_id's 8-hex short-id branch and generic >=4-char prefix branch each call os.listdir(tracker_dir) per candidate, while the alias branch was already bounded by a prior fix.

Replacement of per-candidate full-store resolution with a single indexed strategy (build_resolver_scan_index + bisect prefix-match on sorted dir names) reduces tracker walks from O(candidates) to O(1) per invocation plus linear history parsing.

The fix preserves all reference forms (full, short-id, alias, Jira, four-digit/prefix, trailer, leading-subject), ambiguity semantics, descendant credit, file-impact-vs-diff enforcement, and fail-closed git-error behavior.
